name: Cloak of Displacement

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: Attack rolls against you have Disadvantage, until something damages you (it returns at the start of your turn).
text: While you wear this cloak, it magically projects an illusion that makes you appear to be standing in a place near your actual location, causing any creature to have Disadvantage on attack rolls against you. If you take damage, the property ceases to function until the start of your next turn. This property is suppressed while you have the Incapacitated or Restrained condition or while your Speed is 0.
